cards.text: Isaiah, the prophet, brings a new message: the burden against Egypt. Look, the LORD rides on a swift cloud, and He is coming to Egypt.

cards.question: The LORD is coming to Egypt on a swift cloud. What will happen to the idols of Egypt?

answers.text: They will be carried off to Babylon
They will be hidden in the temples

cards.question: The LORD rides into Egypt on a swift cloud, and the hearts of the Egyptians will ___ within them.

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks: He'll stir up Egyptian against Egyptian. Brother against brother, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.

cards.question: Egypt will be fighting itself, and the LORD says He will frustrate their plans. Who will the Egyptians turn to?

answers.text: Idols and spirits of the dead

cards.question: The Lord GOD of Hosts declares He will deliver the Egyptians into the hands of a ___ master.

cards.text: And the LORD says a fierce king will rule over them. Then the message turns to the Nile, Egypt's great river.

cards.question: In this message against Egypt, what will happen to the waters of the Nile?

cards.text: And it spreads: the canals will stink, the reeds will wither, and the fields along the Nile will blow away. That's like baking with no dough, friend: you're just standing there holding a stamper.

cards.question: With the Nile drying up, the fishermen of Egypt will celebrate.

cards.text: The flax workers will be dismayed, the linen weavers will turn pale, and all the hired workers will be sick at heart. That's a whole lot of folks staring at a riverbed like it owes them money.

The princes of Zoan, a city in Egypt, are mere fools, and the wise counselors of Pharaoh, Egypt's king, give senseless advice. Then the message asks, 'How can you say to Pharaoh, "I am one of the wise, a son of eastern kings"?'

cards.question: Pharaoh's counselors claim to be wise. So the message asks where those wise men are now. What does it dare them to do?

answers.text: Reveal what the LORD has planned
Bring the Nile back to life
Make peace with the land of Judah

cards.text: It gets worse. The princes of Memphis, another Egyptian city, are deceived, and Egypt has been led astray in all she does, as a drunkard staggers.

cards.question: Egypt's leaders are deceived and the whole land has been led astray. Where did this spirit of confusion come from?

answers.text: The LORD poured it into her
Her idols poured it into her

cards.question: In this message, there is nothing Egypt can do, head or tail, palm or reed.

cards.text: In that day, the Egyptians will tremble with fear beneath the uplifted hand of the LORD of Hosts, when He brandishes it against them.

cards.question: The land of ___ will bring terror to Egypt, and whenever it's mentioned, Egypt will tremble over what the LORD of Hosts has planned.

cards.text: Then, out of NOWHERE, the message turns: in that day five cities in Egypt will speak the language of Canaan. One of them will even be called the City of the Sun.

cards.question: Those five cities in Egypt will swear allegiance to someone. Who is it?

cards.text: In that day there will be an altar to the LORD right in the center of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD near her border, a sign and a witness to the LORD of Hosts. Same country, whole new centerpiece.

cards.question: When the Egyptians cry out to the LORD because of their oppressors, He will send them a savior and defender to rescue them.
When the LORD makes Himself known to Egypt, Egypt will refuse to acknowledge Him.

cards.text: They will worship with sacrifices and offerings, and they will make vows to the LORD and fulfill them. I once vowed to keep my apron spotless, and friend, do NOT ask my apron how that went.

cards.question: The LORD will strike Egypt with a plague. What will He do after He strikes them?

cards.text: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria, a mighty empire, with Assyrians going to Egypt and Egyptians going to Assyria. Meanwhile my whole commute is three hops on this gold base, from the oven to the cookie boxes.

cards.question: In that day, the Egyptians and the Assyrians will ___ together.

cards.text: And in that day Israel will join Egypt and Assyria in a three-party alliance, a blessing upon the earth.

cards.question: The LORD of Hosts blesses Egypt, Assyria and Israel. How does He speak of Egypt and Assyria in that blessing?

cards.text: Hear the whole blessing: 'Blessed be Egypt My people, Assyria My handiwork, and Israel My inheritance.' Friend, I'm standing here on my gold base with my mustache over my mouth.
